flags.reason: The Nav Arrow guide (31f1c5e) and its evidence were checked on 29 September 2026 on jfs-components 0.1.77 (its Sources note says “Installed jfs-components is 0.1.77”); the installed package is 0.1.78 (mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02). NavArrow.tsx is the same blob at v0.1.77 and dbe0e02, and every guide-body sentence this entry quotes still holds, but one Sources sentence no longer does, and the entry leaves it out: “In Dark colour mode the chevron currently turns orange because of a token value, so use it on light surfaces.” With Color Mode Dark, navArrow/icon/color now resolves to rgb(241, 241, 241), a light grey, not the orange rgb(255, 153, 0) of 0.1.77 (mode/Grey/400 Dark, fixed for #177 in 636f3f5). The entry also leaves out the Sources note's other limitations (the arrows List Item, App Bar, Section and Summary Tile draw; a decorative arrow announced as an image), which still hold on dbe0e02 but were checked only on 0.1.77. Re-check the guide on 0.1.78 and publish it, then re-extract. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r24, for Marcin to confirm. Guide fix #547.

examples.purpose: A header and a list of accounts, the guide's In context as its example code draws it: a back arrow beside the screen title “Accounts”, as its own button, over two account rows in a Card. The arrow's accessibilityLabel names where it goes (“Back to Home”), as the guide's Content section says. Each ListItem is pressable as a whole and draws its own forward arrow; the empty onPress handlers stand for the screen's navigation (back to Home, or opening that account).
examples.jsx:
<VStack>
  <HStack alignVertical="center">
    <NavArrow direction="Back" accessibilityLabel="Back to Home" onPress={() => {}} />
    <Text text="Accounts" />
  </HStack>
  <Card>
    <VStack>
      <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="Savings •• 0245" supportText="₹1,24,500" onPress={() => {}} />
      <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="Salary •• 1180" supportText="₹48,200" onPress={() => {}} />
    </VStack>
  </Card>
</VStack>

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction of the arrow: 'Back' (left chevron), 'Forward' (right chevron), or 'Down'. Default "Back", from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Modes used to resolve design tokens.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called when the arrow is pressed. Expands the hit area to at least 44×44.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables press interaction when `onPress` is provided. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: ...SafePressableProps
props.description: Inherited React Native props the component also accepts. They are not part of the design contract and no guide documents them.

modes.name: Color Mode
